rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: BTC reclaiming the 200-week MA (~$62.5k) after a shallow correction. Spot BTC ETFs logged five straight days of inflows led by BlackRock's IBIT (+$223.5M most recent net), and Fed Chair Warsh's first dovish signal (inflation risks eased) is a fresh macro tailwind. A short squeeze (~$281M bearish liquidations) is adding fuel.
positions.driver: On a mixed-edge day the strategy favors the most liquid major with the cleanest definable stop and the strongest flow backdrop. BTC has positive/accelerating ETF inflows and a dovish Fed pivot; SOL's +15% week is undercut by a -29% volume drop (weak momentum) and higher beta, and ETH shows net ETF OUTFLOWS (-$42M/wk, 30d -$795M). Buying BTC on the 200-wk-MA reclaim with an 8% stop is the best asymmetric downside-protected setup. Entry = live Kraken spot confirmed twice at run time.
positions.risks: Failure to hold the 200-week MA (~$62.5k) reopens the June ~$58k lows and trips the stop; a hawkish reversal into the Jul 28-29 Fed; altseason rotation leaving BTC to lag SOL. PRICE SOURCE NOTE: dashboard proxy feed was stale (asOf 2026-07-04) and CoinGecko/Coinbase-BTC returned cached/stale values; entry/exit taken from Kraken live spot (BTC $62,942.80, confirmed across two fetches) as the canonical fallback.
